item.title: Organizing the Empathy AI Challenge 2025 Awards Ceremony
item.description:
🎓 More than a month ago, we celebrated the Empathy AI Challenge 2025 awards ceremony at the Empathy.co offices.

Organizing this event was a very special experience for me, which is why I wanted to share this post, originally written in Spanish, the language I speak every day and feel closest to.

I’ve always loved organizing events, it’s something I’m good at and enjoy the process of. That’s why I thank Empathy for the opportunity to build this event from scratch, being able to plan and decide on every detail exactly the way I felt it should be.

While preparing it, I couldn’t help but remember what I experienced years ago, when I took part in the challenge as a student. That experience felt very special to me, and this time it was my turn to be on the other side, with all the excitement and responsibility that comes with it.

I had the support of many people, both within Empathy (design, GenAI, DevOps, web teams…) and outside of it, and that was essential for everything to go well, because working as a team and with respect is what makes us strong 😉

On the day of the ceremony, everything flowed smoothly and the attendees really enjoyed it. I think I rose to such a special occasion, though they made it easy with their interest and participation.

🎁 The reason it took me a while to talk about this is that we were preparing a surprise:

Now the official challenge website has a section featuring all the winners and participants, which will remain as a reminder of all the effort and talent on display:

https://lnkd.in/dNWQhKzR

Thank you to everyone who made this edition possible 😊

item.title: ShuttleCon Third Edition has finished
item.description:
This Third Edition of ShuttleCon has been full of surprises. For my side, I wanted to make a more professional event with details, merchandising and bigger communications.

As always, some things did work, and others didn’t, but everyone smiled and said, “Thank you” when the event ended.

The most important thing was that all the speakers were happy. Pablo and I wanted this event to be the first step for people to start giving speeches about what they are doing. Many people are incredible, and you can lose track of time just by listening to them.

One edition has passed, but the next one is going to be even better ;) Maybe you could participate in it…

PD: I want the resources we created to be remembered, so here I leave the whole video we put at the start of the event.

item.title: ShuttleCon Third Edition
item.description:
Hey, tech enthusiasts and event aficionados!

My job isn’t just about coding and designing software. I can also do one of the things I like most: Organising events.

Last year, I was one of the speakers at the opening of Empathy.co ShuttleCon, an event with talks that repeats every few months, each with a fresh theme. It was a fantastic experience!

I liked it so much that I couldn’t help but become part of the organisation team for the second edition in April with Pablo Cañal Suárez. And now… we are bringing you the third edition!

The ShuttleCon is back! This time, we’re diving deep into the roots with the theme “Mastering the Basics”, because you must first have an excellent base to become the best.

We will have six excellent speakers introducing us to various technologies and themes: Noelia Vigil Suarez, Ricardo Soto Estévez, Andrea López Suárez, Ramiro Alvarez Fernandez, Daniel Rodriguez Ferrero and Andrea Delgado Alonso.

The event will be onsite on Empathy.co Headquarters in Gijón, but also streamed on Twitch!

Save the date – November 30th, 17:30 CET. Head to our event page for more information, the form to attend onsite and the reveal of talks’ titles. 😉

Get ready for an evening of tech talk, inspiration, and a surprise or two. See you at ShuttleCon 3.0 🚀🌐
